semanticReview.finding: The actual asked object set and decision dimension are fixed before cross-matching related source units. Unexamined/unshown items are distinguished from source-unstated dimensions. Existing outside-scope/missing-required-premise unknown handling remains explicit below; unknown is not replaced with default permission.

Bulk positive, negative and unknown statements are checked against their actual covered objects and dimension. If the set was not checked, assertions narrow to checked items and supported unknowns. This preserves known permissions, prohibitions and results without inventing closed-world assumptions, a fixed table, mandatory template or domain answer.

Complete parallel source actions and nonfield effects, actual common/independent inputs and overrides, necessary versus sufficient predicates, decisive full-criterion AND/OR dependencies, domain versus reachability, local reusable scope, exclusivity versus terminal equality, lifecycle and source/design recovery attribution, per-example missing-item calculation and no ability scores remain intact in unchanged text.
